== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[That's It, The Rebels Are There! (Japanese)|That's It, The Rebels Are There!]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/151452828/Xd3SHXuxh0CpDVL5j86Wuw.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 151452828.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>08f5a32a6a1e3829f0f0fb5ce286d3b72820e61b15fd79246eb134eeff61c75c</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
